speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo; to help me understand your condition, how long do these episodes typically last?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

Given the specific description of position-dependent dizziness and spinning sensations in a 70-year-old woman with presbycusis, the clinical picture strongly suggests BPPV. Have you noticed any associated symptoms such as hearing loss, tinnitus, or ear fullness during these episodes?
